description: Whispr Notes brings your voice memos into ChatGPT with semantic search: it finds notes by meaning, not just keywords, and pulls the most relevant ones into your conversation. From there, do anything an AI session can do - recall past ideas, summarize weeks of thinking, turn spoken thoughts into drafts and plans, or answer questions from what you've already captured. Agents can use it the same way, bringing your voice notes in as context. Read-only and scoped to your account: it can only search and fetch your own notes, never change them.

defaultPrompt: I keep rambling into Whispr Notes about what to charge for the app. Find those voice notes.
